documents.title: Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018
Quarterly Compliance Report on Corporate governance - within 21 days from the end of the quarter

analysis.summary: ABS Marine Services Limited reported strong financial performance for H2 and FY26, driven by owned fleet expansion, disciplined execution, and cost management. Total income for FY26 grew by 75.05% year-on-year to INR322.64 crores, and EBITDA increased by 179.17% to INR152.55 crores. During H2 FY26, the company inducted the offshore support vessel Artemis into its owned fleet and plans further vessel additions. Management remains optimistic about offshore demand and anticipates around a 10% increase in turnover for the upcoming financial year. ABS Marine Services Limited reported its financial and operational performance for the half year and year ended March 31, 2026, highlighting a total income of ₹322.64 Cr and net profit of ₹80.80 Cr on a consolidated basis.

guidance.claim: Management expects a 10% increase in turnover from current levels for FY27, assuming all vessels run in the second half.
guidance.quote: As regards the guidance on the top line is concerned, we can expect a 10% increase -- assuming that all the vessels will be running in the second half.

guidance.claim: Management expects EBITDA margin to continue in the band of 45% to 50%.
guidance.quote: As regards the EBITDA is concerned, I am sure that currently it is in the band of 45 to 50. I am sure that that will continue.

demand_outlook.claim: Favorable demand-supply dynamics in the offshore vessel market are supported by an aging global fleet and limited new vessel additions.
demand_outlook.quote: Additionally, favorable demand-supply dynamics in the offshore vessel market, supported by an aging global fleet and limited new vessel additions, continue to improve utilization levels and charter rates across segments.

demand_outlook.claim: The company stated that offshore investments are rising steadily across continents.
demand_outlook.quote: Offshore investments are rising steadily across continents

capex_expansion.claim: During H2 FY26, the company successfully inducted the offshore support vessel Artemis into its owned fleet.
capex_expansion.quote: As part of this strategy, during H2 FY26, we successfully inducted the offshore support vessel, Artemis, into our owned fleet, expanding our vessel ownership portfolio and improving our ability to participate in higher-value offshore projects.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is scheduled to take delivery of an offshore supply vessel in Q1 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Further enhancing our offshore capabilities, we are also scheduled to take delivery of an offshore supply vessel in Q1 FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: The total cost of acquisition for both new vessels, Hades and MPSV, was about $15 million.
capex_expansion.quote: Just a moment. We have totally, we have spent about $15 million for both the vessels.

capex_expansion.claim: The company received delivery of the offshore vessel AM PASSION in H1 FY26.
capex_expansion.quote: Received Delivery of Offshore Vessel – AM PASSION

margins_costs.claim: On a consolidated basis, total income for FY26 stood at INR322.64 crores with an EBITDA margin of 47.28%.
margins_costs.quote: On a consolidated basis, total income stood at INR322.64 crores, registering a robust growth of 75.05% year-on-year. EBITDA increased significantly by 179.17% to INR152.55 crores, while the EBITDA margin expanded sharply by 1,763 basis points to 47.28%.

margins_costs.claim: For H2 FY26, consolidated total income stood at INR183.11 crores with an EBITDA margin of 51.46%.
margins_costs.quote: During H2 FY26, consolidated total income for the period stood at INR183.11 crores, registering a growth of 78.93% year-on-year. EBITDA surged by 164.64% to INR94.23 crores, while EBITDA margin expanded significantly by 1,667 basis points to 51.46%.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that improved utilization levels, better margin realization, and disciplined cost management contributed to healthy growth in revenue and profitability.
margins_costs.quote: Improved utilization levels, better margin realization, and disciplined cost management have contributed to healthy growth in both revenue and profitability.

orders_capacity.claim: The company operates a diversified fleet supported by over 2,000 seafarers and shore-based professionals.
orders_capacity.quote: Today, we operate a diversified fleet with offices in Mumbai, Kochi, Singapore, and Kakinada, supported by over 2,000 seafarers and shore-based professionals.

orders_capacity.claim: Out of the eight owned vessels, five are on long-term charter, two have recently come out of charter, and one newly acquired vessel is pending dry dock.
orders_capacity.quote: Out of the eight vessels that we own, five of them are on long-term charter, three of them -- two of them have just come out of charter, and third one is just we have acquired, so it has to go into the dry dock and then only come out and then only we put her in the market.

orders_capacity.claim: The company secured strategic contracts exceeding ₹350 Cr.
orders_capacity.quote: Over ₹350 Cr in Strategic Contracts Secured

capital_allocation.claim: The company follows the tonnage tax scheme where tax is paid on the tonnage of the vessel rather than earnings.
capital_allocation.quote: So, what they do is they tax not as per the earnings, they tax on the tonnage of the vessel.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that the exchange rate movement from INR82 per dollar to INR96 has impacted the cost of vessel acquisition.
risks_headwinds.quote: Other than that, I don't see much change in this because from what we were paying INR82 per dollar, it has gone up to INR96. So, that is playing on the cost of the vessel.

management_commitments.claim: The company has signed a five-year contract with Hardy Oil for the vessel Hades.
management_commitments.quote: We have already got a charter with Hardy Oil for a five-year contract and...

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to expand and add seven to eight vessels over a period of two to three years.
management_commitments.quote: I think Captain has already told that the vision is to expand and to go forward for seven to eight vessels over a period of two to three years.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated a continued commitment to building a robust asset base that drives operational efficiency, enhances service delivery, and supports sustainable long-term growth.
management_commitments.quote: We stay committed to building a robust asset base that drives operational efficiency, enhances service delivery, and supports sustainable long-term growth.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
